# Getting Started

RECAP captures experimental provenance through resources, process templates,
and process runs.

This User Guide is the tutorial track. It will take readers from installation
through a complete local or remote workflow. Task recipes live under
**How-To Guides**, conceptual material under **Explanation**, and API details
under **Reference**.

## Current Tutorial Entry Points

- [Current end-to-end quickstart](https://github.com/nsls2/recap/blob/rest-api/docs/quickstart.md)
- [Current query guide](https://github.com/nsls2/recap/blob/rest-api/docs/querying_data.md)

These links preserve existing material while it is rewritten into the Diataxis
structure.
